Which of these shapes will come in place of A and B, such that no two shapes having the same number of sides, pattern, or colour appear in the same row or column?
Note: Not all blocks will necessarily have a shape present in them
a)
b)
c)
d)
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Starter
decide how to begin
Begin with A. List what is already in its row and in its column: the number of sides, any pattern and the colour.
Slicer
break it into small parts
Make three checks for each option: sides, pattern, colour. Then do the same for B, using its own row and column.
YOUR TURN
Cross out any option that fails even one check for A or for B.

Six concrete blocks of cubical shape are used for building the stairs as shown below. How many faces of these blocks are not visible?
a) 12
b) 15
c) 21
d) 24
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Turn the picture into a sum. There are 6 cubes and each cube has 6 faces. How many faces are there in all?
Slicer
break it into small parts
Split the stairs into the left column and the right column. For each cube, count the faces you can see: front, top or side?
YOUR TURN
Take the faces you can see away from all the faces.
16
